records.title: Final Letter to Abbey on 10/2/24
records.notes:
10/2/24: My final email I sent to Abbey:

Subject: I hope this letter finds you well

Dear Abbey,

I hope this letter finds you well. It’s been far too long since I’ve had the chance to reach out, and there’s so much I want to share with you. I believe you deserve to hear my side of things after all these years.

I have tried multiple times to connect with you over the years, but I was blocked each time by either your mom or your Uncle Ken, Although I am very sorry for your loss as I know you were very close. Your mom made me sign a document in court that stripped me of all parental rights, threatening to take me to court for back child support and potential jail time if I didn’t comply. I was scared and didn’t have the means to hire a lawyer, so I felt I had no choice but to sign it. Please know that I did not want to do this with all my heart, and I hope you can forgive me for it. I understand that this may have been a reason for your distance from me, but I think it’s important for you to know the truth before my time on this earth is over.

Please allow me to explain. At the time of your mom's pregnancy, I had already broken up with your mom for about four months prior. I received a call while I was working as a security guard at the Genetics Institute in Andover, MA. I’ll never forget that moment. She told me she was pregnant with my child, but I struggled to believe it completely. She went away to a camp at Lake Winnipesaukee, NH, where she had gone almost every summer, and mentioned she had met someone there before. We had a history together, and I was engaged to her many years prior to your birth. During that time, she admitted to cheating on me with someone from "the camp at the lake." So we broke back up then and I was heartbroken. Because of that, trust was hard for me to maintain, and I couldn’t be sure of the circumstances surrounding your conception.

I hope you understand why this uncertainty leaves me wondering if you are my daughter. Whether you are or not, I just need you to know my side of the story and I will leave it up to you to decide what you want to do with it. I sincerely wish you all the joy and success life can bring. Your happiness matters to me, regardless.

The circumstances surrounding your birth and early years were incredibly complicated, and I wish things had turned out differently. Your mother faced tremendous pressure from her family, particularly from your Uncle Ken, who became a barrier to our relationship. I wasn’t making enough money for him to approve of my relationship with your mother, and he made it his mission to keep us apart. In my desire to be closer to you, I even went so far as to marry your mom, hoping it would allow us to spend time together, but when Ken found out, he intervened again, determined to break us up simply because I didn't make enough money as a Security Guard at the time and you know how controlling he could be. He did this by threatening your mom to take away the money that he had put aside for her in his will.

Shortly after that, I found my footing in the IT field and began earning much more. Unfortunately, Ken didn’t have faith in me or give me the chance to prove that I could be a worthy husband to your mom. The weight of his disapproval was heavy, and it made an already difficult situation even harder. So she was threatened by Ken once again that she would lose her inheritance in his will and was forced to divorce me. The marriage only lasted about a few months because of this. I was heartbroken once again.

I’ve always thought about you and hoped for the best in your life. I’ve heard about your recent marriage, and I want you to know that I’m genuinely happy for you. You deserve all the love and joy that life can bring.

Please know that I think about you often and wish you nothing but happiness. If you’re open to it, I would love to hear from you when and if you feel ready.

I want you to know that you are in my thoughts and prayers every day. The hope of reconnecting with you fills my heart with warmth, and I truly believe that regardless of the path we've been on, there is still time for us to create something beautiful together. You deserve all the love, happiness, and support in the world, and I hope to be a part of your journey, however that may unfold.

I know this is a lot to take in, but I thought you should know the truth. Whether you decide to do anything about it or not, I just need you to know the truth before my time on this earth is over.

With love,

Richard Berube
